title: Operator Helm post-upgrade job crash causing mutating webhook backlog in customer VPC clusters
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Summary: During several Private/VPC customer upgrades from operator 1.4.1 -> 1.4.3 the Helm post-upgrade job (operator-postupgrade) crashes intermittently, leaving the mutating/admission webhook server in a NotReady state. That causes an admission queue backlog which blocks new pod creations (customers see 5xx errors and long delays). Hosted/Dedicated customers unaffected; impact limited to on-prem/VPC clusters that have KMS-backed secret rotations enabled and a short reconciliation window.

Investigation notes:
- Root cause appears to be a race between the Helm post-upgrade job and the secrets reconciler. The post-upgrade job validates a secret hash (used to signal migration completion) against the live secret. In some clusters the KMS-wrapped secret changes during upgrade due to scheduled rotation, producing a hash mismatch and the job exits non-zero.
- When the job exits it does not fully requeue the operator leadership handoff; operator pods briefly crash-loop and the webhook server fails liveness probes. Clients attempting to create resources hit the admission webhook and time out or receive 500s.
- Logs: operator-postupgrade container shows error "secret hash mismatch: expected abc123 != got def456" followed by panic in reconcile loop (stack trace attached in incident page).
- Affected customers identified via incident tags: cust-redwood-42, cust-dataworks-7, cust-telecom-x. PagerDuty incident PD-43192 created.

Immediate mitigations applied: 
- Hotfix rollout: built operator image operator:1.4.3-hotfix1 which turns the post-upgrade job into a non-blocking best-effort validation and retries secret read with exponential backoff. Deployed to affected customers during maintenance windows. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/operator/pull/2345
- Manual workaround documented for customers who are mid-upgrade: 1) kubectl -n redwood rollout restart deploy/operator-controller-manager; 2) kubectl patch secret <name> --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/metadata/annotations/upgrade-hash","value":"<current-hash>"}]' to sync hashes. Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/OnPrem+Upgrade+Hotfix+Runbook
- Temporary alert: added a Prometheus alert for webhook_queue_length > 100 for 2m across on-prem clusters.

Customer communication:
- Sent targeted emails and notes to incident contacts for impacted accounts with steps and scheduled hotfix windows. Support ticket list appended to the incident.

Decisions and trade-offs: 
- We chose a minimal hotfix that avoids risky schema/secret migrations in the immediate window. The hotfix trades off a possible transient window where the post-upgrade check may be skipped in favor of keeping the webhook available. Longer-term fixes will reintroduce strict validation with safer migration semantics and canarying.

Next steps / long-term remediation: 
- Implement Helm pre-upgrade hook to snapshot the secret hash and an idempotent migration plan so post-upgrade jobs compare against a stable snapshot rather than live secret. (Follow-up ticket planned.)
- Add an e2e upgrade test in CI that simulates KMS secret rotation during upgrade.
- Harden operator leadership handoff so webhook readiness is guaranteed or fallback is served (shielding existing API calls).
- Add automated canary rollouts for operator chart upgrades in Private clusters (configurable by customer).

Artifacts / references:
- GitHub PR (hotfix): https://github.com/redwood-inference/operator/pull/2345
- Hotfix release notes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/operator/releases/tag/1.4.3-hotfix1
- Runbook & customer playbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/OnPrem+Upgrade+Hotfix+Runbook
- PagerDuty: https://redwood.pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-43192

comments: 2026-03-10 - Aisha Kapoor: Initial report from SE. Customer cust-redwood-42 saw operator webhook 500s during scheduled upgrade. Filed PD incident and triaged as P0.
2026-03-11 - Miguel Santos: Reproduced locally by forcing KMS key rotation during helm upgrade. Confirmed post-upgrade job exits with secret hash mismatch. Captured logs and stack trace.
2026-03-12 - James Liu (SRE): Deployed operator:1.4.3-hotfix1 to staging, validated webhook stays Ready after repeated secret rotations. Metrics show queue drain within 15s.
2026-03-13 - Customer Success: Notified affected customers, scheduled 30m maintenance windows for hotfix deployments. Contact list updated in incident.
2026-03-14 - Miguel Santos: Rolling hotfix to first 3 customers in batch 1. Post-deploy checks passed; will continue to roll out to remaining clusters.
